data.name: Alyse
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Alys', meaning 'Goddess of the harvest' or 'Raised by God'. In the New Testament, the name Alysios is borne by a man who is a disciple of Paul. In the apocryphal Acts of Paul and Thecla, the name Alysia is given to a female disciple of Paul.

in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word αλυσεω (aluseo) meaning 'to nurse, to nurture, to cherish, or to tenderly care for.'

in_latin.name: Alisia

in_english.name: Alyse
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old French word 'alyse' meaning 'helping,' or the Old English word 'ælf' meaning 'elf' and 'sigef' meaning 'victory,' resulting in the meaning 'elf of victory.'
